notes.title: Racine Update - v1.1.1 (+ Humble precisions)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

As some of you might've seen in the last few days, there's been different updates. There was one recent polish update that caused some people to be blocked, so we had to revert that version. Here's the 1.1.1 version with a fix for this problem 
Version 1.1 is now live : 
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue related to texture size crashing the game, notably when fighting "barrel" type enemies
[/list]

Also, even if it would seem some people don't believe us even though it happens with different games ;
We cannot really do anything when Humble is out of key for a game. We try to refill the keys there as soon as possible, however we [b]do not have full control on key generation[/b], as Steam has to validate key batches. 
On Humble, people claim keys but sometimes don't use them. Steam then sometimes denies key creation, as there are still a lot of unused keys (that have still been claimed by people, so there's no real reason for us to revoke them). 
We have to wait until more people activate their keys, so we can ask for more, and give them to Humble as a refill

It's not the first game we've got problem with when it's on Humble, unfortunately probably not the last, and we're not the only publisher with this issue. But please be assured that we're doing our best to provide keys as soon as possible!
We thank you very much for your patience

Have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Racine update - 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here's the patchnote for today's update!

[list]
[*]Changing "Good Fortune" charm's Ki accumulation bonus rate from +0.3 to +0.2
[*]Fixing a bug where the effects of "Minimalism" card were activated twice when played
[*]Tweaking the speed of stats changes at the end of the fights
[*]Adding the possibility to skip the animation of statistic changes at the end of the fights, either with left mouse button or with the validation key
[*]Adding a security that prevents fights starting without ennemies
[*]Tweaking the spawn method of Merchant and Challenge tiles, so they won't move between updates
[*]Fixing a bug where Merchant and Challenges tiles were spawning where they were not supposed to
[/list]

notes.title: Racine has a release date!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Great news! We are pleased to announce that Racine, the roguelike autobattler, will be launching on [b]November 6th![/b]

[previewyoutube=8PHUTkmEd2A;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Features:
[/b][/u]
- Dynamic real time combat
- Increasing intensity
- Optimize your character
- Build your deck carefully
- Gather various praying cards in ancient shrines and sites
- Uncover the secrets behind the spirits' bursts of violence
